messages.subject: Project Willow - draft heads of terms
messages.plaintextBody:
Catherine, Tom,

Attached is the draft heads of terms reflecting the headline enterprise value of £42.5m on a cash-free/debt-free basis, the £2m / 18-month retention and exclusivity to the longstop. The cap on general warranties is left open for negotiation. Grateful for comments before we send to Castle & Vane.

James

messages.plaintextBody:
James - these look good. Happy with the £42.5m and the retention structure. Push hard on the warranty cap; we'd like 50% as the opening position. Go ahead and send to the other side.

Tom
